assessment.intro: This assessment follows the standard criteria of the Department of Mental Health, Ministry of Public Health to screen your mood, stress level and early signs of depression.
assessment.step1: Step 1: Read each question in every part carefully, in order (2Q, 9Q and 8Q).
assessment.step2: Step 2: Answer honestly based on how you really felt during the stated period (2 weeks or 1 month).
assessment.step3: Step 3 (important): You must answer every question in every part (19 in total). Otherwise the submit button stays disabled.
assessment.step4: Step 4: Once everything is answered, press "Submit Assessment" at the bottom to see your results and support options.
assessment.struct1: 1. 2Q screening (2 questions): checks for sadness/loss of interest over 2 weeks
assessment.struct2: 2. 9Q assessment (9 questions): measures symptom severity over 2 weeks
assessment.struct3: 3. 8Q assessment (8 questions): assesses self-harm risk over 1 month
assessment.heroDesc:
Your digital companion for a better life
A quick, friendly check of your mood and stress that reflects how you feel each day
assessment.q2how1: 1. Reflect on how you have felt over the past 2 weeks
assessment.q2how3: 3. <u>Both questions must be answered</u>, along with the other parts, before you can submit
assessment.q2rule: Answering "Yes" to any question (even just one) suggests a tendency toward depression; the result is then combined with the 9Q assessment.
assessment.q9how1: 1. Consider how often each symptom occurred over the past 2 weeks
assessment.q9how2: 2. Pick a score from 0 to 3 for each item based on actual frequency
assessment.q9how3: 3. <u>All 9 questions must be answered</u> to calculate the total and unlock submission
assessment.q9criteria:
• Score < 7: normal / no or very few symptoms
• Score 7 - 12: mild depression
• Score 13 - 18: moderate depression
• Score ≥ 19: severe depression
assessment.q8how1: 1. Reflect on your thoughts, feelings and behavior over the past month
assessment.q8how2: 2. Choose "No" (0 points) or "Yes" (scored by the weight of that item)
assessment.q8how3: 3. <u>All 8 questions must be answered</u> for an accurate and complete result
assessment.q8criteria:
• 0 points: no current tendency toward self-harm
• 1 - 8 points: mild tendency
• 9 - 16 points: moderate tendency
• ≥ 17 points: severe tendency

assessment.q8Note: A score of 9 or more means high risk. Please see a psychiatrist or call the 1323 hotline right away.
